data.narrative:
Airbase is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Ari Rosner and Millen Anand that has raised $5M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 10 comparable companies across public and private markets—2 public names (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression modeling uses the $5M raised as a proxy for current value and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progression, implying a $12M valuation. Peer-median analysis across 5 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—Stark Defence ($4.0B Series A), UFORCE ($1.0B Seed), Castelion ($1.0B Series A), Singularity ($400M Series A), and NODA AI ($125M Series A)—yields a median of $1.0B, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $11M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $506M. The wide range reflects material uncertainty in peer comparability; stage-progression and peer-median methods diverge substantially, suggesting that Airbase's specific defensibility, market timing, and founder track record remain material to final valuation. The peer set skews toward later-stage, higher-valued companies, which may inflate the median. Clarity on revenue, unit economics, and customer traction would narrow this band materially.
